summary: Banco de Chile furnished its interim consolidated financial statements as of June 30, 2026, via a Form 6-K under Rule 13a-16. The filing includes reviewed financial information, statements of financial position, income, comprehensive income, cash flows, equity changes, and notes. It is a routine periodic disclosure of quarterly results by a foreign private issuer, with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or activist campaign. The filing merely satisfies SEC reporting obligations for foreign issuers. No transaction terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned; this is standard financial reporting with no investment implications beyond the bank's operational performance.
